svg.aria-label: Nine gate verdicts on the same 349 unseen questions, each drawn as an accuracy delta in percentage points with its 95 percent confidence interval: v6, v7, v9, v10, v11, v12 and sdk_v2 straddle zero and were rejected; v8 at plus 4.58 and sdk_v1 at plus 8.88 cleared the one-sided cluster-corrected McNemar test and were promoted.
